evidence.quote: I intend to recommend that the Board re-propose the Basel endgame and G-SIB surcharge rules.
Taken together, the re-proposals would increase aggregate common equity tier 1 capital requirements for the G-SIBs, which are the largest and most complex banks, by 9 percent.
That's why it is important to get the balance between resiliency and efficiency right.
